description: Minister of Transport Highways Parts and Civil Aviation - Merchant Shipping Act. No 52 of 1971 Merchand shipping (vessel Classification and Certification) Regulations No.03 of 2024.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It establishes new regulatory frameworks for vessel classification, certification requirements, inspection procedures, and operational standards for merchant shipping. The content focuses entirely on legal/regulatory matters - creating new subsidiary legislation under an existing Act, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
